title: Aperture Night Ops Field Docket
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight working docket for a constrained night-window rollout (the 'aperture') that exercises new model-routing heuristics and a micro-optimization in the serving runtime. The goal is low-risk validation under reduced traffic so we can collect tail-latency signals and auto-eval samples before any broader daytime expansion.

Scope & guardrails:
- Traffic slice: EU region first; 0.5% -> 1.5% -> 2% across nights.
- Window: daily 00:00-06:00 UTC (PST night ops).
- Nights planned: Nov 12	6 (3 sequential nights with final decision on Night 3).
- Safety: immediate feature-flag rollback and prebuilt emergency hotpatch.

Nightly cadence (ops timeline):
- Night -1 (prep): Nov 11, 20:00 PST 	6 run smoke harness, sync baselines, warm caches.
- Night 1: Nov 12, 00:30 PST 	6 deploy to 0.5% (ramp 15-30m), hold 4h, collect metrics.
- Night 2: Nov 13, 00:30 PST 	6 ramp to 1.5% over 30m, hold 6h, eval samples.
- Night 3: Nov 14, 00:30 PST 	6 optional expand to 2% if signals green; otherwise rollback and iterate.
- Post-watch: Nov 15 	6 24h anomaly surveillance and final telemetry snapshot.

Pre-launch quick checklist (owners in parens):
- Canary infra allocation verified and prefix cache warmup run (Miguel).
- Sampling toggles enabled for per-route latency, KV-cache stats, and model token usage (Claire).
- Temporary alert channel created (#aperture-night-ops) and escalation map circulated (Ravi).
- Rollback artifacts staged: rollback PR, feature-flag playbook, hotpatch creds tested (Asha).
- Stakeholder notify list confirmed: product-owner, infra-sre, on-call, security.

Watch triggers (immediate abort criteria):
- 95th percentile latency > 2x baseline for 10+ minutes.
- Absolute 5xx increase > 0.5% sustained for 5 mins.
- Auto-eval drift: rerank/quality metric drop > 4% on golden prompt set.
- KV cache miss-rate sustained > 20% and correlated tail-latency.
- Unexpected daytime traffic leakage > 0.2% of daytime load.

Operator rollback flow (short):
1) Confirm alert and surface baseline comparison.
2) Notify on-call lead and assign responder.
3) Execute feature-flag flip: infra-cli flags set model-routing-aperture false.
4) Verify route table and health endpoints.
5) If flip fails, use emergency reroute to local-capacity pool (ops-runbook).
6) Tag traces and start forensic capture for postmortem.

Post-deploy smoke checks (fast):
- Health endpoint for canary shard returns 200 (3 checks).
- Run 10-sample prompt suite and compare outputs to golden checksums.
- Verify per-request token billing does not spike (sanity check).

Communication templates:
- Slack (announce): "Starting Night 1 aperture: 0.5% traffic to staged routing. Monitoring latency and 5xx. Pager on-call SRE. Reach out in thread for changes."
- Incident stub (rollback): subject: "Aperture rollback 	6 <short reason>" body: timeline, metric snapshots, who executed rollback, immediate mitigations.

Open questions / action items:
- Warm-cache migration: need a plan if KV topology shifts.
- Rate-limiter interactions when proxying across regions; confirm no cross-region token bursts.
- Add a hard timeout for hotpatch runner locks to prevent long operational blocks.

Release notes (draft):
- Summary: Night-window rollout of model-routing policy and a serving runtime micro-optimization targeting tail-latency.
- User impact: none expected; rollout limited to low-traffic windows and auto-rolled back on regressions.
- Timeline: staged nights Nov 12-14, 2026; post-watch Nov 15.
- Guidance: no action required; customers may notice slight changes in generation timing during the aperture windows only.

Post-watch deliverables if green:
- Merge annotated telemetry snapshots into Confluence and attach trace bundles.
- Plan next cadence: small daytime mini-cadence at 5% across low-traffic hours.
- Finalize and publish customer-facing release note and internal debrief.

Appendix: useful commands
- Check routing table: infra-cli route list --filter=aperture-night
- Flip flag: infra-cli flags set model-routing-aperture false
- Capture traces: traces-cli capture --tag=aperture-night --duration=10m > aperture-traces.tar.gz

Field journal (live notes):
- 2026-11-12 00:50 PST 	6 ramp to 0.5% complete. Latency within baseline; KV miss rose briefly to 9% for ~7m. No 5xx spike.
- 2026-11-12 02:05 PST 	6 observed token-count increase on sample prompt #7; traced to gateway templating change. Patch applied to gateway rules; no rollback.
- 2026-11-13 01:10 PST 	6 expanded to 1.5%; small tail-latency blip correlated with one edge node; drained and observed normalization.

TODOs:
- Draft warm-cache migration playbook with infra-sre and rehearse script.
- Add automated golden prompt snapshot to post-deploy hooks.
- Decide APAC night-window inclusion for next aperture run.

-- end sketch --
